title: The HVP Mind: An Exact Derivation from Harmonic Arithmetic to a Native Conversational Answer
description:
A conversational AI you can check by hand: no neural weights, no attention layers, no backpropagation, no floating point. This 152-page paper derives one complete turn of the native MindHVP as an exact integer state transition, from the HCL fixed-point operations to the last byte of the answer. The answer was calculated from the system's observed live state, then matched exactly by the unchanged running system.

The release also includes GUHCT: Complete Theory of Everything, Full Edition 6 (848 pages), the theory the paper is built on. The book is included without its illustrations to keep the file light; the images are publicly available.
